0022600130.text: The Sacramento Kings (0-3, on a three-game losing streak and 15th in the West) head to San Antonio to face the Spurs (1-2, riding a one-game winning streak and 10th in the West), with both teams having played three games so far this season. Sacramento is missing Ben Simmons (Achilles, surgery), Dylan Cardwell (calf strain), Keegan Murray (ankle), and Maxime Raynaud (knee, dislocated), while San Antonio is without Jayden Quaintance (knee, surgery) and Tobias Harris (calf strain). The teams have not met yet in the 2026-27 season, and in 2025-26 the Kings lost all three meetings, most recently 132-104 in Sacramento on March 17, 2026.
